verdict.rationale: Dagster is primarily an orchestrator; its own docs don't describe native cursor/incremental-record tracking for syncs. It does integrate with tools that handle this (dlt's DltLoadCollectionComponent, Fivetran, Airbyte connectors represented as assets), which implies incremental/cursor-based sync happens via those delegated tools rather than Dagster itself. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of Dagster's own state/cursor management for incremental syncs, partition-based incremental materialization details, and evidence of 'no full reloads' behavior guaranteed by Dagster rather than by the underlying connector.
